    for j in range(n):
        p[i][j] /= 100.0

mask = [0] * n
for i in range(n):
    for m in range(1 << n):
        if not ((m >> i) & 1):
            mask[i] |= (1 << m)

state_map = {1: 1.0}
for i in range(n):
    new_map = {}
    for entry, value in state_map.items():
        for j in range(1 << n):
            prob = 1.0
            res = 0
            for k in range(n):
                if (j & (1 << k)):
                    prob *= p[i][k]
                    res |= ((entry & mask[k]) << (1 << k))
                else:
                    prob *= (1 - p[i][k])
            new_map[res] = new_map.get(res, 0) + value * prob
    state_map = new_map

print(f"{state_map.get((1 << n) - 1, 0):.9f}")
